predict: LOGICOL stands for Logically-Informed Contrastive Learning. It is a framework or objective designed for dense retrievers, particularly for set-based dense retrieval tasks. LOGICOL aims to enhance the performance of retrievers by incorporating logical information into the contrastive learning process. This approach is especially useful for queries containing logical connectives, allowing for more accurate and relevant results. The framework builds upon in-batch supervised contrastive learning and has been shown to provide cleaner separation in query embedding representations, indicating its effectiveness in improving retrieval tasks.
